result.description: Set up monitoring for a brand from scratch, including competitors.

content.text:
Set up monitoring for ExampleCo (https://example.com).

1. Call list_monitors first to see what already exists — do not create duplicates.
2. Call get_usage to check how much quota is left before adding anything.
3. Create a monitor in the my_brand group for ExampleCo. Include every
   spelling people actually use: the plain name, the spaced form if it is
   CamelCase, the @handle, and the bare domain.
4. Ask me which competitors to watch, then create one monitor per competitor in
   the competitors group.
5. Suggest exclude_keywords if the name collides with something common.

Tell me what you created and roughly when the first mentions will appear.
Do not create alerts unless I ask for them.
